note: One home for the beat map: video/review/build_review.py renders it on the review page and writes video/beat_map.md from it. Times are estimates until the TTS files exist. 'say' is the narrator unless a line starts with 'Coach:' (the coach's own, flatter voice). 'screen' describes everything visible. Words that appear on screen are in double quotes and stay at 5 or fewer per screen; eyebrows such as NO MEMORY · 13:28 are evidence labels and don't count.

beats.label: The hook
beats.say: Ever thought of having a coaching chef in your house, teaching you to cook? Or even designing your own?
beats.screen: The learner's head-camera view as a meal begins: ingredients come out of the fridge, then the onion goes onto the chopping board. Over the footage, centred white text: "Your own coaching chef?", with "coaching chef" in italic serif. Nothing else on screen.

beats.label: The catch
beats.say: But build one, and you bump into problems. Our first coach told our learner to crack the eggs fourteen times. The eggs were already in the pan.
beats.screen: Hard cut to the eggs cooking in the pan, full screen. A small white coach card slides in top-left: eyebrow NO MEMORY · 13:28, line "Crack the eggs." A big red counter beside it rolls from ×1 to "×14" while the line is spoken.
beats.sound: The music dips; a soft tick on each count.

beats.label: Chapter 1 · It repeats
beats.say: Without memory, a coach repeats itself. Coach: Crack the eggs. Crack the eggs. Crack the eggs.
beats.screen: On a pale green paper card, a red numbered square "1" and the title "Without memory" for one second. Then three hard cuts: the onion on the chopping board, the phone, the oil spray. Each shot gets the same red card "Crack the eggs." and the counter steps "×1", "×2", "×3".

beats.label: It forgets
beats.say: It forgets what you did. Our learner cracked the eggs at five minutes. At nine, it asks again.
beats.screen: Close-up of the learner cracking eggs into a bowl. At the bottom, the egg step icon fills green with "5:13". Hard cut to 8:54: the bowl of whisked eggs sits by the stove while the learner fetches a plate; the red card returns, eyebrow NO MEMORY · 8:54, "Crack the eggs."
beats.sound: Tick as the icon fills, pop for the card.

beats.label: It can't tell what's done
beats.say: And it can't tell what's finished. The eggs are on the plate, and it says: heat the pan and add the onions.
beats.screen: The learner scrapes the scrambled eggs onto a plate. The red card appears: eyebrow NO MEMORY · 13:59, "Add the onions." The shot holds on the finished plate for a moment.

beats.label: The turn
beats.say: So we gave our coach a memory.
beats.screen: The whole frame becomes solid memory green. Centred white text: "What if it remembered?", with "remembered" in italic serif. A slow push-in.
beats.sound: The music drops out for this beat.

beats.label: Chapter 2 · Learn your way
beats.say: Start wherever you like. Our learner gets the plate ready first, then chops the onion, and the coach goes along: fine, do it in parallel.
beats.screen: A green numbered square "2" and the title "With memory" for one second. The learner takes ingredients from the fridge; green card, eyebrow MEMORY · 0:39, "Plate first? Fine." Hard cut to the onion being chopped; card "Keep going."
beats.sound: The music returns; pop on each card.

beats.label: It remembers
beats.say: Every action it sees is written down against a recipe step, so it always knows what has started and what is left.
beats.screen: A row of seven round step icons appears along the bottom, all grey outlines. Four two-second shots follow (the plate, the onion, the pan, the eggs), and with each one its icon fills green and shows the moment it was first seen: 0:13, 1:50, 4:36, 5:13.
beats.sound: A light tick on each fill.

beats.label: Only when it's needed
beats.say: It only speaks up when something is needed. The onions will need a hot pan, so it reminds you to oil the skillet. A couple of minutes later, you do.
beats.screen: The onion chopping continues; a green card, eyebrow MEMORY · 2:07, "Oil the pan first." Hard cut to the learner spraying oil into the pan; the pan icon in the step row fills with "4:36".

beats.label: Another dish
beats.say: On a bacon and egg sandwich, it suggests shredding the cheese while the eggs cook, and reminds you to season the eggs before you build the sandwich.
beats.screen: Bacon and eggs in two pans; green card "Shred cheese meanwhile." Hard cut to the learner cutting a baguette; card "Season the eggs first." Hard cut to salt going over the pan; the seasoning icon in a six-icon row fills with "9:19".

beats.label: Chapter 3 · How it works
beats.say: Here's how. Meta's V-JEPA 2 world model watches the video and answers: what is the learner about to do? Muse Glimmer, the coach, reads the memory and answers: what matters now? And Liquid AI's d1 turns that into one next move, every second.
beats.screen: A numbered square "3" and "How it works". On pale green paper, white cards appear one at a time, joined by dashed arrows: Video, V-JEPA 2, Memory, Muse Glimmer, d1, Next move. The card being named lights up green with its question underneath: "What's next?", "What matters?", "One move." The kitchen keeps playing in a small rounded square, bottom-right.
beats.sound: A soft tick as each card lands.

beats.label: The secret: memory
beats.say: The secret is the memory. Each action, take egg, cut onion, spray oil, is mapped back to its recipe step, with the moment it was first seen.
beats.screen: On paper, a timeline of small action chips runs across the top ("take egg", "cut onion", "spray oil"). As each is spoken, its chip lifts off and drops into the matching slot of the step row below, which then shows its first-seen time.

beats.label: The result
beats.say: After the eggs were whisked, the coach without memory asked to crack them five more times. With memory: once. It still misses what the camera can't see, and that's what we're working on next.
beats.screen: Two tinted panels side by side, pale red and pale green, under a small eyebrow ASKED TO CRACK EGGS AFTER 7:41. Big numbers count up: "5" in the "No memory" panel, "1" in the "Memory" panel. They hold while the limit is said.

beats.label: The close
beats.say: Your own coaching chef, one that remembers what you've done.
beats.screen: The finished plate being seasoned, dimmed. White text: "Your own coaching chef.", with "coaching chef" in italic serif, echoing the opening. Then a paper card with the project name and the credits: built with Meta V-JEPA 2, Muse Glimmer and Liquid AI d1; footage HD-EPIC, University of Bristol, CC BY-NC 4.0.
